source_units.text: Write a closing argument in a fictional mock trial.
Aim the wording at the jury in a fictional classroom mock trial.
Include the following invented details: The invented case concerns a missing silver bell.
The evidence is an open window and a feather on the sill, while no witness saw the accused enter the room.
Argue that suspicion alone does not settle the story.
Preserve these exact phrases: "the silver bell", "an open window", "no witness saw".
